evidence_for: Higher-timeframe trend agrees with the long: H4 context (freshness current) is bull-trend/breakout-spike with bars 113-120 closing 2577.69 to 2760.51 (seven of eight closes higher) and the 2700.00 equal highs of H4 bars 106/116 exceeded (closes 2723.15, 2754.31, 2760.51).

M15 bar 118 is a bull reversal bar (open 2768.60, low 2768.42, high 2779.05, close 2776.18) closing in the top quarter of its range and above bar 117's high 2769.23, giving a specific pending stop (2779.05) with structural risk only 16.12 below it at 2762.93.
evidence_against: M15 bar 113 (open 2771.06, high 2804.59, close 2803.78, range 34.81, widest of the leg) broke the bar 95 high 2795.00 by only 9.59 and was fully retraced in three bars to 2767.94 (bar 116 low) - a marginal new high that was immediately rejected.

Last bar M15 bar 119 (open 2776.18 = its high, close 2768.10 = its low) is a bear bar closing at its low and takes out bar 118's low 2768.42, so buyers lost the most recent bar and a deeper second leg toward 2746.20/2734.22 is possible.

Location is only neutral: 2768 is near the middle of the M15 range 2718.09-2804.59 (mid ~2761) and about 25 points under the 2804.59 high, so reward to first resistance is roughly 1.6x the 16.12-point risk.

H4 context flags possible buy-climax character overhead: H4 bar 118 range 191.94 with a 126.85 (66%) upper tail to 2850.00, and H4 bars 119-120 contract (76.91, 35.81) with highs 2795.00 and 2770.03 below 2850.00, so supply sits just above the trigger.

Three consecutive M15 bear bars (114, 115, 116: closes 2783.49, 2781.77, 2768.05) mean the first bull attempt after the leg down already failed, and a High 2 buy could print lower, near 2762.93-2747, rather than the 2779.05 stop triggering.
uncertainty: Whether this is a tradeable High 1/High 2 pullback or the start of a broader M15 trading range 2734.22-2804.59: bar 119 already took out bar 118's low 2768.42, so the pending 2779.05 stop may simply not fill while price works lower to 2762.93-2747.
The H4 buy-climax shape at 2850.00 is unresolved (no bear reversal bar printed), so a bull leg resuming could still stall at 2804.59/2850.00.

H1 and H4 contexts are directional labels; the raw H4 bar 118 upper tail shows the 2850.00 spike was sold, so the higher-timeframe leg may be shifting from spike to channel or range rather than extending.

Two consecutive M15 closes below 2734.22 (bar 103 low) break the sequence of rising M15 lows and end the bull-leg read.
